title: Blood in the airway
summary: A gunner took fragments to the face and scalp and is unconscious. Blood keeps running into his airway faster than you can clear it, and you have one suction bag. Secure the airway for good.
objectives: Check the airway and clear it (head turn, suction)
Establish a surgical airway: palpate, vertical cut, horizontal cut, hook, Cric-Key, cuff, stylet
Secure the neck strap and stitch the incision (incisions bleed until stitched)
